intended_scope: Second-look historic LTL invoice review and net cash contribution methodology, pending independent buyer rights and security/legal signoff.

references.why: Voluntary enterprise privacy risk management framework; not a legal certification
Reporting recruitment, sample frames, sample sizes, nonresponse and research limitations; not a freight product endorsement

stages.name: Buyer authority, data rights and representation
Original invoice and governing evidence chain
Net cash, reversals and publishing controls

gates.name: Document a specific buyer's authority
gates.required_evidence: Separately authenticated buyer authorization with legal-entity identity, signer capacity, covered accounts, dated approval and permissible research uses.
gates.why_missing_blocks: Claims or analytics on another entity's invoices could exceed the purported signer's authority.
gates.next_internal_step: Prepare a blank authorization checklist and owner-of-record verification procedure.

gates.name: Determine written agency and carrier-contact authority
gates.required_evidence: Executed representation/engagement terms identifying permitted internal audit, carrier claims, publicity limitations and jurisdiction-specific counsel review.
gates.why_missing_blocks: Permission to inspect a bill is not necessarily permission to contact carriers, make claims or waive defenses.
gates.next_internal_step: Separate internal read-only pilot scope from eventual carrier-facing authority.

gates.name: Establish all upstream data and license rights
gates.required_evidence: Rights inventory for invoice, BOL, contract, tariff/NMFC, payment, vendor/API and third-party records, with permitted retention and onward processing.
gates.why_missing_blocks: Third-party materials may be visible to the shipper but not authorized for transfer, reuse or redistribution.
gates.next_internal_step: Draft a document-by-document source ownership and redistribution rights inventory.

gates.name: Define data minimization and sensitive-field rules
gates.required_evidence: Field allowlist with owner-approved purpose, classification, redaction/segregation requirements, and exceptions process for sensitive financial and personnel information.
gates.why_missing_blocks: Unbounded document ingestion may expose unnecessary confidential or personal data.
gates.next_internal_step: Write a sample field-level redaction matrix without actual invoice uploads.

gates.name: Demonstrate controlled transfer, access and isolation
gates.required_evidence: Reviewed secure transfer design, encryption/key management, tenant isolation, least privilege, audit logs, and incident escalation with documented test evidence.
gates.why_missing_blocks: A signed study contract alone cannot demonstrate the system protects buyer records.
gates.next_internal_step: Prepare architecture and adversarial access-control review artifacts, without enabling production import.

gates.name: Approve deletion, retention and breach handling
gates.required_evidence: Owner-approved retention duration, data erasure/revocation verification, backups/export policy, and incident response obligations tied to contractual requirements.
gates.why_missing_blocks: No generic storage TTL can substitute for specific data owner obligations or verified deletion.
gates.next_internal_step: Create a human-review retention and deletion control worksheet; assume no standard legal TTL.

gates.name: Bind each invoice to shipment and immutable source records
gates.required_evidence: Signed/rights-cleared original invoice identity, shipment/BOL/POD metadata, dates, freight mode, duplicate-key controls and independently reviewable file checksums.
gates.why_missing_blocks: An apparent billing duplicate may be distinct loads or an internal join error.
gates.next_internal_step: Design a minimal shipment-invoice linkage manifest with unknown and duplicate states.

gates.name: Establish dated governing rate and tariff precedence
gates.required_evidence: Contract amendments, carrier scope, tariff/NMFC editions and effective dates governing each selected shipment, independently validated for use and licensing.
gates.why_missing_blocks: A current public tariff or a future supplement is not automatically governing historical rate authority.
gates.next_internal_step: Produce a source-version decision tree for independent rate reviewers.

gates.name: Independently reconcile bill, payment, credit and refund
gates.required_evidence: Payment-ledger originals with dates, chargebacks, applied credits, refunds, partial amounts, currencies and duplicate reference reconciliation.
gates.why_missing_blocks: Invoice errors and ledger credits do not prove the buyer paid excess cash or remains owed a refund.
gates.next_internal_step: Specify a cash-versus-credit evidence table and closed-loop source reconciliation.

gates.name: Freeze an unbiased prospective invoice sample frame
gates.required_evidence: Time-bounded eligible invoice population, carrier/mode/size strata, sampling selection rule, exclusions, missing records, deduplication and nonrespondent accounting.
gates.why_missing_blocks: Cherry-picked known bad invoices overstate error precision and ignore false negatives.
gates.next_internal_step: Draft a versioned cohort manifest with empty actual row set and a bias checklist.

gates.name: Preregister sample size, metrics and stopping decisions
gates.required_evidence: Independent approval of primary estimand, denominator, sample size/power rationale, missing/abstention rules, adjudication threshold and stop conditions.
gates.why_missing_blocks: Retrofitting thresholds after seeing outcomes risks an unsupported success conclusion.
gates.next_internal_step: Prepare preregistration and independent statistician-review templates.

gates.name: Establish comparator and negative-control fairness
gates.required_evidence: Same frozen invoice/rate evidence given to reviewers and authorized methods; document preprocessing, withheld labels, false positives, no-alert cases and comparison permissions.
gates.why_missing_blocks: Unequal access, hindsight corrections or only flagged positives bias apparent sensitivity and competitor comparisons.
gates.next_internal_step: Create blinded comparison and negative-control coverage definitions.

gates.name: Separate two human reviewers from RETALLY alert author
gates.required_evidence: Individually accountable independent reviewer identity/qualification, conflict checks, assignment audit and proof alert labels were hidden before initial determination.
gates.why_missing_blocks: Two labels generated by the same software are not independent human agreement, even if both say blinded.
gates.next_internal_step: Write a dual-reviewer separation-of-duties and label-sealing workflow.

gates.name: Resolve disagreement through documented third-party review
gates.required_evidence: Third qualified reviewer or prespecified arbitration with issue taxonomy, abstention preservation, original vote retention and defensible reasoned resolution.
gates.why_missing_blocks: Majority inference or overwriting original disagreements can launder uncertain alerts into truth.
gates.next_internal_step: Prepare an immutable disagreement docket and escalation template.

gates.name: Require source-linked case decisions and adjudication quality
gates.required_evidence: Case-level evidence IDs, reviewer evidence access log, contradictory-source handling, error taxonomy, inter-rater diagnostics, and corrected labels with version history.
gates.why_missing_blocks: Unattributed labels and self-reported reviewer accuracy do not establish a reproducible ground truth set.
gates.next_internal_step: Define a complete label provenance schema and denominator disclosure format.

gates.name: Trace permitted fees to actual collected cash
gates.required_evidence: Signed effective fee base plus independently reconciled bank receipt, carrier payment versus credit, recovery allocation, collection reversals and charge timing.
gates.why_missing_blocks: A carrier credit or ledger notation must never be reported as a cash fee collected by RETALLY.
gates.next_internal_step: Prepare fee-recognition source audit tests using only fictional reversal examples.

gates.name: Include failed cases, labor and downstream refunds
gates.required_evidence: Full inception cohort cost ledger, no-fee outcomes, time spent, acquisition/processing expenses, writeoffs, refunds, residual liabilities and double-attribution controls.
gates.why_missing_blocks: Excluding failures and costs can invert apparent contribution margin and overstate recoveries.
gates.next_internal_step: Predefine fee-eligible contribution per initiated case and variance checks.

gates.name: Separately authorize external claims, publication and disposal
gates.required_evidence: Final legal/commercial/security review of customer release rights, claim wording, PII/confidentiality redaction, explicit external representation and source destruction obligations.
gates.why_missing_blocks: Passing code tests or having an internally complete pilot packet does not permit marketing claims or carrier action.
gates.next_internal_step: Create a final human release-readiness decision memo template; public usage stays blocked.
